title: One letter
note: The first letter sits under its month, whose opener is lit: "THIS MONTH", the month, "1 letter · From Mama" and its dates. Read together appears once there is at least one letter in the book.
text: Asha's book Read together This month The first weeks 1 letter · From Mama October 31 to November 29 Saturday, October 31, 2026 You laughed at the dog today, a whole belly laugh. From Mama Tonight Book Family A gentle nudge, now and then? A couple of evenings a week, at a time you pick. Never late at night. Yes, evenings Pick a time No reminders
lines: You laughed at the dog today, a whole belly laugh.
A gentle nudge, now and then?
A couple of evenings a week, at a time you pick. Never late at night.
